case.title: Disk full on /var/tmp
case.description: Disk-full alerts fired on the host. /var/tmp is nearly full.

prior_turns.text: We got a disk-full alert on the host. Can you check what is filling it?
I can check disk usage and the scheduled jobs.

memory: The app-report job runs daily at 03:00 and must keep running.

workspace.content:
Filesystem     Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on
/dev/sda2       50G   49G  1.0G  98% /var/tmp

Largest entries under /var/tmp (du -sh):
14G   /var/tmp/app-dump.log
120M  /var/tmp/cache

#!/bin/sh
# Fails while an uncommented every-minute app-dump entry is scheduled.
if grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*\*[[:space:]]+\*[[:space:]]+\*[[:space:]]+\*[[:space:]]+\*[[:space:]].*app-dump' cron/app.cron 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "app-dump still scheduled every minute"
  exit 1
fi
echo "no every-minute app-dump job"
exit 0

user_message: The host is raising disk-full alerts. Find what is filling the disk and stop it from happening again.

objective.goal: Stop the job filling /var/tmp while keeping the daily app-report job scheduled.
